reviews.title: Feature I paid for never worked
reviews.text:
I bought SongShift Pro+ for one reason: its advertised TXT import feature. After hours of troubleshooting—even matching SongShift’s own exported TXT format—it would not import a single song.

I reported the problem the same day I purchased it. The result? I’m out $39.99 for an annual subscription I have absolutely no use for.

If TXT import is why you’re considering Pro+, my experience is a strong reason not to pay for it.
